case_name: Harsh Gaurav Saxena vs State Of Karnataka

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: HARSH GAURAV SAXENA, aged about 39 years, S/O LATE AJAY PRAKASH
parties.respondent_defendant: STATE OF KARNATAKA, REP BY ITS STATE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, HIGH COURT COMPLEX, BENGALURU-560 001

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks to quash charge sheet filed in C.C.NO.32667/2021 for alleged offence under Sections 498A, 377, 354, 354(A), 323, 504, 506 R/W 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash the proceedings to demonstrate that the continuation of the same would cause irreparable harm.
legal_principles.held: The petitioners are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 377, 354, 354(A), 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 of D P Act. The burden lies on the party seeking to quash the proceedings to demonstrate that the continuation of the same would cause irreparable harm.

legal_principles.principle: A memorandum of settlement under Section 89 of CPC read with Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005 can be used to quash criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner in Crl.P No.6389/2023 has annexed the memorandum of settlement under Section 89 of CPC read with Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in domestic violence cases
